reviews.text: Travel made easy. I am a huge planner, being able to see and plan based on proximity in big cities, making the most of your time so you aren’t zig zagging is huge. This app is great and so helpful
Great trip planning!!!. Wanderlog makes trip planning so easy. You can have everything in one place and find great locations! Love it!

A Trip Planner for this planner. GREAT App! I’m always planning trips for others…so when I found this APP it felt like this Personal Assistant got a Personal Assistant. I use the free version and it’s perfect. Love the easy access to maps, and yelp. Love the Itinerary Views. It’s really a great App. Love the suggested activities and the ability to swipe left or right and adjust itinerary in real time.
SO USEFUL. This app scratches my brain so good. I’m able to add in all the details, costs, locations, etc! It keeps my ADHD brain super organized.
Excellent Organization!. I have planned many trips in the past couple of years with Wanderlog! I love that there’s an option to print a pdf as well
Amazing App. Really enjoying the organization of this app. Everything in one place. I also printed reservations etc but also having everything in this app is perfect. Would definitely use again!

Ease of Adding Areas of Interest. Using the app is a little more difficult than using a laptop. It seems you have to go to different areas to find information. Also difficult to move items in the itinerary around. Maybe I need to use it more to understand it.

Favorite App. I'm not a planner, and last year I tried manually doing everything in Notion but this app is amazing. I went from hand-creating my own spreadsheets to create budgets and track payments, to an app that imports your confirmations and easily helps you split payments between people - for FREE! I accidentally got the pro version after forgetting to cancel, and it even gives me flight updates and terminal changes because it scans my emails. This app makes me love planning! And I love its ideas for places to go, and the ability to visually see your places on a map. I was able to rearrange my itinerary based on a more efficient layout. It estimates time between places too!

Very helpful with planning. When you take a 10 Day road trip to New York, Annapolis, DC, and West Virginia with four people, planning can get very complicated. Thankfully, I found Wanderlog before this trip, which made planning so much easier. I loved being able to save various restaurants that I read about on travel blogs and videos, all right there organized for when it was time to eat. Definitely will be using for future trips!

WANDERLOG IS MY PASSION. i’m a chronic traveler and wanderlog is literally my bible. i use it every single time i travel and i got all my friends to be on it too. i’m superrrr type A and plan all the trips we go on as a group and it really puts everything we want to do on the map so we can schedule accordingly. i love that you can see the yelp links and it routes to google maps when i need to. it even flags days when restaurants or places are closed. I cannot get enough this is my church and i am in attendance.

Amazing!. I used Wanderlog to plan my family’s two week European vacation and would use the app again and again!!! Having my daily itinerary, walking maps, tickets and reservations all in one place was an absolute dream!!!

I love this app. I love planning trips and enjoy spreadsheets, but I wanted something with all the info in one place. This app met my expectations and more. One of my favorite features is that you can see the drive time between places on your daily itinerary. I’ve already shared this app with multiple trip planning friends.

Me encantó !!!. Siempre planeo los viajes familiares y vacaciones y apenas este año descubrí esta app y me encantó . Me ayudó muchísimo y facilito todo mi planning para Europa . Muchos tips, sugerencias , ver los itinerarios diarios y los mapas ayuda mucho.
Muy recomendada !!!
Great app. Really loving this app. It’s been super helpful on our roadtrip. Only suggestion is to add a photo snap feature in the expense area. Would make it easy to keep track.

Wonderful app, Wonderful features. I LOVE this app. Literally everything you can ask for in a travel planning app and then more. I love how modular the itinerary design is. My favorite future is the ability to see how far away to destinations are from each other. It’s also so collaborative i love it

Perfect Trip Planner!. My daughter introduced me to Wanderlog prior to our trip to NYC last November. It is a fantastic tool for collaborative, remote planning with a group. We compiled our list of places we wanted to visit, viewed the locations on the map to optimize our time, and then moved the places to our itinerary. It even has a feature to record and split costs for expenses! Our family LOVES Wanderlog!
Wanderlog Apoyo y Acompañamiento Excepcional. Excelente recurso. Referente importante en un viaje en grupo.
Plan switch. Monthly plan does not exist and shouldn’t be shown. Charged for full year.

Wonderful for a complex trip. We used Wanderlog for a three-week multi stop trips with three Amtrak legs, a car rental, and lodging in both hotels and AirBnB’s and the app helped us keep track of all of our bookings in one place. Forwarding the reservations to the app was easy and the information automatically-populated mostly seemlessly. We only had to make one in-app correction to a booking. Thank you to the founders for creating this great app! We’d definitely use it again. 😊

Not Working. I purchased the Pro version about 10 months ago. I used it for four month although the Pro features appeared to not work for me. I’ve had the subscription for 10 months now and want to use it again. I couldn’t log in. The website and app said there was no such user id. Someone claiming to be a co-founder said he fixed it but all I got is a new account. My Pro access is gone. I’m left to wonder if I paid for something that I never received from them. I tried loading a flight having a layover and the app reversed the cities on the initial leg. That’s not good work for a basic import process. It doesn’t look good for a renewal for another year on this app.

Incredibly helpful. IMO this is excellent for people who frequently travel with others (and solo as well). It lets you add people so you can collaborate and all see the plan and be on the same page. The tips, tools, and suggestions are awesome. Been using WL for years now!

Very useful and time saver. I just became a recent subscriber and I was really impressed with the pro features. Although the UI is a little complicated, I tried to spend more time learning how to use it. It makes trip planning so much easier instead of copying and pasting websites. I loved the AI feature to help plan routes.

Excellent customer service. Heads up, DO NOT use the apple ID "hide your email" option when you sign up. I had no idea what issues this can cause if you ever need to log out of apps or reset your phone. Luckily they quickly available to explain what can happen and in figuring out how to get me back into my account. The app is excellent on its own but the customer service stands out. Thank you!
Best travel app for cities. Just used this for a trip to London, the ability to map out our trip, navigate from place to place through the app, was perfect. Can’t wait to use for the next trip

Deleted all of my plans. I originally loved this idea and was having a blast planning my trip. I spent about 2 hours doing tedious planning and when I logged back into the app 1 hour later, all my plans had been deleted. It made me log back into my account and I still had my previous trips yet it deleted my most recent one. This app was such a great idea and I was really wanting to like it.

A necessity for Big Trips. We had a fairly packed 12-day trip to Paris and London in April 2026, with a lot of places to wander, shop, and ticketed activities. Wanderlog kept it all in one convenient app.

I especially loved the route optimization. If a place on our to-see list was near a museum we were visiting, it was easy to add it to that day’s itinerary and put everything in order to avoid crisscrossing the city. The multiple lists, filterable on the map, were also great. For example, if we needed a spot to eat during unplanned time, we could pull up the map and see what we’d bookmarked nearby. This let us mix tightly- and loosely-planned activities without ever feeling stuck on what to do next.

Forwarding email confirmations to the app was nice too, and it parsed details well most of the time.

I used practically every feature at least a bit. I’d have liked to use journaling and expenses more, but didn’t make time for them daily. I’d planned to track expenses to keep better tabs on spending and adjust as we went.

My one piece of feedback: an export feature would be great, so we could share a simple itinerary with friends or family looking for trip recommendations, without having to give them access to the full in-app itinerary.

Was great until the latest update. I really loved the free version of this app, the best feature was the map, you could add attractions you wanted to visit in each city and then view them on the map super easily. In the most recent update I guess they got rid of that though, tragically halfway through my trip and now I just have to use Apple Maps. No way I’m paying for the premium version, I loved that this was an accessible travel tool but that’s over now. Shout out corporate greed I guess
Helpful. Wanderlog is a helpful travel partner. I like how it will give you suggestions of things to do on the area. Travel time to and from locations is helpful in planning the days

Obnoxious in-app purchase checking popups. I was about to become a subscriber, but not after having this app essentially cripple complete use of a device because I needed to clear hundreds of incessant "in-app purchase not allowed" alerts after installing this app. As a privacy and security focused professional that frequently travels, I was very much looking forward to utilizing this aesthetically beautiful app and website. However, until this garbage coding nightmare is corrected, I cannot in good conscientious recommend this as an app for any device.
After 20 question.. After I load the app after 20 questions, the free turns into four dollars a month.
Great travel app!!. Easy to use, organizes all of your trip information beautifully.

The hype is reaaal. I friggin love this app. It makes planning trips so incredibly easy. Sometimes if I just have a lot of stuff going on in the city that I live in I’ll use it simply because I can just input places and see how far/close things are so I can plan accordingly. It’s seriously addicting to just plan out future trips. I love it. I love that when you start adding things to your itinerary it will tell you how long the commute between places will be

Ring Road trip planning. This app was so helpful in planning our Ring Road trip around Iceland. Kept all our stops organized and helped pace the days so we were not overextended and could enjoy each stop. Also very helpful in updating our changing flight information with our linked tickets.

Most helpful app ever!. I am blown away by how easy this app makes trip planning. I love seeing all my reservations auto-populated with exactly the information I need into my itinerary. There are hidden gem attractions I never would have found all easily organized. I can’t believe how great the free version of this app is!
love this app!. As the planner of our friend group, this app has been exactly what I’m looking for to create and share travel itineraries and details. Thank you!!!

Would give it 6 stars if possible!. Loved how much helpful and useful information it provided us for planning activities. From driving distances, best order of events, and closures or reservations requirements, it made my family feel like we had a professionally planned trip. Will definitely use it again.

User Friendly Travel app. This app makes it so easy to add your bucket list for a trip and organize an itinerary based off of it. I love being able to see the distances between each location and how I can categorize each item on my list.

Need to manually add a LOT. I have three email accounts with travel info. I forward emails to Wanderlog but none show up. I click on “start” to learn how to do things, nothing happens. I am wasting a LOT of time negotiating an interface that leaves a lot to be desired. 
I see now why I canceled after the free trial. A month later, I mistakenly bought an annual plan after reading a glowing review of what this app can do. So far, it is not doing ANY of those things, and I’m wasting a lot of time manually doing what the app claims it will do. 
BUYER BEWARE. 
I’d file for a refund if I could get it.

Great way to keep everything together. Im happy to have just one place in which to view flight info, lodging, transport and tickets! Much easier than wading through emails. It takes a minute to figure out how to download tickets and then you’ll be all set.

Well-rounded travel app. App is great to visualize your trip and make an itinerary. You can add important information like hotel, transit and flight info. It has a great feature that’s is linked to google, AllTrails and yelp which is great to source related content. This is a great well-rounded app.

Type A Traveler’s Dream. Are you a freak with color coded binders? Are you the travel buddy who makes sure everyone got to the airport on time with the appropriate luggage? Do you know the restaurants of a city before you visit better than the locals. Then you need Wanderlog
Tough to Navigate. There are many, many features that making this tough to navigate on an App. Learn the lay of the land on a desktop browser first and it makes a lot more sense.
Impressive. Just started using Wanderlog. Love it. Very impressed.

Cluttered, not useful for actual travel. The app is cluttered, unintuitive, and contaminated with irrelevant ‘recommendations’. It’s ok for vicarious armchair fantasy travel but worse than useless for actual travel. Unfortunately I was 1/2 a day late canceling the (useless) free trial so I contributed a years subscription to the author for no benefit and attempting to use the app actually made my trip more stressful.
Easy Peasy. I feel like I’m more organized with my trip info all in one place. The best part is that I can share the itinerary with my family so they can take the lead once we arrive.
Awesome Travel App!. Fast & responsive… accurate downloads from gmail… simply outstanding resource! Intuitive navigation, terrific visuals, excellent guidance,useful links & helpful recommendations

Awesome app, better customer service. I have loved using Wanderlog from the first time my wife introduced me to it. We use it to plan all of our vacations, even weekend getaways. However, I had an issue logging in and I had to contact customer service about linking my account information to a new email address. One of the cofounders got back to me right away and continued to email with me until we got it completely resolved. Wanderlog is the best of both worlds, combining efficient technology, and carrying people.

🥰. Так и не понял сути приложения, 5 минут проходил бестолковый опрос + не смог пройти регистрацию ника, не говоря уже о нерабочем состоянии приложения в моем регионе, за что и дарю всем иностранным приложениям соответсвующую оценку

Super useful to make the most of a trip. Wanderlog helps you plan your trip by anticipating transportation times and showing you when you’ll be where. This helps to maximize your time at the places you want to be, and gets you there at the right time of the day (e.g. for photography or ticketed entry). You can plan gas and food stops as well to make sure you’re not scrambling to find those things on the road. When you pay a lot of money to go on a great vacation, you want things to go smoothly and get the most for your money. Wanderlog helped us do exactly that! On a 17-day road trip, we hit every stop and we were also able to be flexible, spending more time at places we were having fun at. So you get a structured plan, but you can leave room for spontaneity. Amazing tool.
K. App Froze

Organizing & Optimizing. Wanderlog has been great for organizing information for an upcoming road trip. Using travel times, it has also helped us optimize what makes sense. When I was had a question about the app, the co-founder emailed me directly and was so helpful. Can’t wait to keep using Wanderlog - it’s exactly what I was looking for and more!

An incredible helpful app for trip planning. This app has helped me plan multiple complex trips while allowing family members to weigh in on the aspects of trips that most interest them. It’s also so useful to have itineraries of past trips available to quickly reference or send to friends who are interested. Love it!
Great travel app. I love this app. It helps me organize my travel plans all in one place, find places to explore and eat and keep track of my budget.

Great app. This app is a game-changer! Used all kinds of other apps for travel before but Wanderlog has every thing needed all in one app. Makes it so much easier than having the hotel app, foodie app, airline app etc and have to keep switching between them during the trip. Everything all in one app has saved me so much frustration! This lets you EASILY share trip info too. Great app!
Expensive. Expensive product for something that is mostly AI.

Perfect app for travel planning. I use Wandelog for all my travels. It gives your an itinerary, keeps all your reservations in one place for convenient access and even catches errors if bookings for the wrong dates were made.

All inclusive travel all. I really love the multiple tools available in the app. The adding budget tracking to split costs with friends is a big bonus and makes settling trip expenses super easy. The map is perfect for planning and searching for potential destinations. I also enjoy sharing my trip after for people that are interested for their future planning. Great app and a must have for travel planners.

I love the map. This app is seriously so helpful in planning my trips, especially with friends and family. We can all add to the itinerary, we can save any reservations and hotel rooms in there, and (my favorite part) there’s a map that shows how to get from one part of your trip to the next destination. It’s a very tidy place to keep and share all your info about your trip.
Awesome app for travel planning. Incredibly helpful for planning, especially to map out distances between places!!

Surveys and ads, non-stop. My wife picked this up to organize a Japan trip. She sent a link sharing the trip. Did not work, kept forcing me to answer survey questions and trying to sell me an upgrade. Finally got it to work. Opened the app a week later and got the same bs and our trip details are gone. Whatever benefit the app might offer are outweighed by it not working and generally being painful to live with.

The best trip planner with friends. This app is amazing. I found this app two years ago when I was planning a trip with 4 other friends of mine who had android and Apple phones. We needed an app that will share our trip plans- this app went above and beyond. We could plan down to the minute details and it was definitely stress free for us. We all were aware of the plans at all time because we just had to check the app when in doubt.

trips are 100x smoother now. my wife and i use this for everything, if it’s not in wanderlog, it doesn’t exist. our travel moods are so much better now, everything is organized, documented, and panned ahead of time so we can just focus on enjoying ourselves
Love to Plan.. Hands down the best travel plan log around.
wtf. The app is NONSTOP crashing for me today. Planning a task and then the site says reload and it’s all gone. Over and over and over again.

One of my favorite apps. I rarely write reviews, but I genuinely love this app! It’s so well-designed and intuitive. Love how seamlessly I can import hotel reservations and flight itineraries. Kudos to the developers.
Fantastic placing assistant. I downloaded this simply to see if it could help me organize a trip better and I ended up buying pro because it’s so perfect!
Great travel app. We are a family of six and this app was perfect to collaborate and plan our trip! Highly recommended.
Scam to get $$. Couldn’t even see distance from CA to TN, how yo split up trip, miles or time?? Not good for a road trip.., easier to use Google Maps/Waze and they are free!

Great travel app!. Wanderlog is such a fantastic app for planning trips. I used the free version for years, and it’s fantastic - but I regret not upgrading sooner. The pro version is even better and well worth the subscription.
Trip. Made planning a trip so easy
My review title :3. Good for trip planning

Great App for Travelers. I love how easy this app is to aggregate all my information. Building the itinerary has been amazing. I can link reservation emails to the places we are visiting. I can use their AI tools to either suggest places to visit or to make my sightseeing more efficient. I can’t recommend this more highly, absolutely a game changer for planning my vacations

Enough with the unsolicited tips. After about 17 pop-up tips while trying to plan and optimize a route I decided to end my subscription. There’s a tour at the beginning that could encompass all of this or give us the option to view one later. Also, why does the path disappear on the map when we zoom in on the map?

Perfect tool. Wanderlog has made trip planning so much easier, and I really appreciate everything you can do with it, even just the free version! This was perfect for my trip to Paris, and I wouldn’t have managed to see everything I did without it.

Everything in one place!. I have been using this app for a while to plan everything from a weekend trip to multi-location international travel. It helps so much to keep everything organized and allows me to plan some things and leave other things up to how the day is going.
Excellent planning tool. Really helps keep all your plans/bookings organized
Greatest app to plan a trip. It’s so easy to use, the suggestions, the expense tracking, I just can’t travel without it.

App Doesn't Smoothly Do Things. The app promises you the world but continuously fails to deliver on very basic stuff like logging in consistently or adding itineraries. The amount of bugs in their system makes me wonder what terrible place they outsourced building the app to.

First time international trip. Such a great app! I’m always skeptical about paying for apps. Tried the free trial and knew it was worth it for the year subscription. Going on year two of using Wanderlog. It makes planning so easy! You can share your itinerary with family so they can help you stay safe. You can codesign an itinerary with everyone you’re traveling with. You can add notes, prices, checklists, files, pdfs, you name it. I’m a spreadsheet person when it comes to planning but I’ve transferred over to Wanderlog for all my vacation needs.

Perfect for planning and organization. The app is great for planning trips and storing all the key information you need. The free version doesn’t restrict or bombard you with adds. My wife and I have used it on simple weekend trips, Ireland and are now planning Italy with another couple.

Highlights are the ability to store reservations, split expenses and mapping out points of interest directly in a map.
Adding photos. I wish there was a way to add photos/screenshots to the notes section

Incredibly helpful, even the free version. We’ve used this several times now to plan family trips. I’d like to plan less and experience more, but with kids it’s safer to make plans to do things that they’ll actually enjoy. Selecting locations of interest, and then making a daily itinerary feel like premium features, and really make the planning so much better and enjoyable.

The BEST travel app I’ve ever used.. I paid for the premium, 100% worth it. I’m type B, and I’m notorious for losing things, mixing up plans, etc and this helped me plan my entire solo trip to Rome so I knew exactly where everything was at all times. The integration is so seamless there’s a little to be done, just upfront to create your trip. The sharing part is so amazing traveling with someone else, they don’t even need to have a Wanderlog account share everything that’s included. The explorer part is one of my favorite features, that allows you to search different things to do places to eat etc and shows you images, google reviews, descriptions, costs, etc all together in one click.
Waste of time Would not open Start Itinerary- waited 10 minutes just to see spinning circle.. Thx for nothing

Requires an Account. This may be a great app. Unfortunately, like some other apps, it REQUIRES you to “sign up” for an account before you can use it. As a new user, I don’t know yet if I’ll like the app, so there should be a way to try it, or at least see what it can do, BEFORE I create an account. So, I immediately uninstalled. Fix that, and maybe I’ll try it again.
Amazing app. Period.. Can’t imagine doing any trip without Wanderlog. It’s now a must whenever traveling.

Couldn’t plan the trip to Europe without it. Wanderlog has been an absolute godsend in planning a four week trip to Europe! I have done all the planning myself for a group of 52 of whom are not in our family and it is just been amazing. I cannot recommend this app Hiley enough.
Outstanding!. A student showed me this as I was talking about a trip- they said it was a must have, & boy they were right!!

Travel made easy with everything in one place. Our family has used Wanderlog on trips within the United States and internationally. It is user friendly, can be shared with your traveling group, and/or can be setup by a travel agent and shared fully loaded for you. Use it once and you will never go back. The app allows you to put everything from flights to hotels to car rentals to tours in one place, but our favorite Wanderlog feature is the real time nearby suggestions with reviews and with just a click driving or walking directions. Wanderlog truly makes traveling easy with everything in one place!

Amazing trip planning app. I have planned many complex overseas trips and this app is making my current plans SO much easier to manage. I can forward all the reservations and tickets to a designated email address and it imports the details directly into my plans. You can search for other people’s recommended itinerary and add individual activities to specific days on your plans. It even tells you the travel time between places you have picked for each day. To top it off it creates a journal of everywhere you visit and you can add notes, photos, and share with friends. Truly an amazing resource!

Everything needed to plan a trip in one app. I’m so happy to have found this app. It makes planning travel easy and intuitive. I love that I can see all activities in one map. I like that others can help with planning. The AI features are really helpful.
Slow and out of sync. Not responsive, login is extremely slow, UX is full of bugs, and trip is out of sync between devices and shared visitors.

Glitch Haven. This app has done nothing but glitch, close, freeze and just not work since I downloaded 10 minutes ago. 
I paid for the 7 day free trial membership which is supposed to be better? 
I’ll give this app another few days to see what’s up. Otherwise this stays a 1 ⭐️
AWESOME app for creating itineraries. I looooove this app. It’s so intuitive and easy to use. It just improved 100 times my trips’ planning process.
The best way to collaborate on a trip. I send an invite link to the whole family and everyone can see our hotels, and add places to our itinerary! So easy to collaborate with friends and family.

Fantastic travel app!. This app is so helpful. My friend discovered it. We are taking a 3.5 week trip to Europe and it easily uploads travel docs. The thought of having to write everything out was too overwhelming. I will use this app again. Highly recommend

Good free services. I just started using this app, but I truly appreciate the support of its free features wo a subscription. Wanting to have a good trip and plan it well is stressful and this def helps!

Euro trip. Tried to use this app for a Europe family trip this summer. Bought the year package but found it cumbersome and difficult to use personally. Company would not refund the subscription. Disappointed.
Useless. You won’t use it. They didn’t send me a notification before my trial ended.

THE BEST travel app. I love Wanderlog! I use it for tracking my budget as well as my itinerary and I love that you can see other people’s published trips as well. I just upgraded to premium and am loving the Gmail auto sync it’s already saved me so much time. Highly recommend!

so organised!. this app is excellent for trip planning, it’s so easy to type in your places to visit and then select from the options. I like to have instagram pulled up and just input locations that I’ve saved to visit. you can also add notes if you need to remember a specific thing about a place, such as when to go or what you want to remember about it. 5 stars for such a convenient interface and navigation.

Suddenly wrong information about opening hours :(. I’ve used this app to plan a few trips and found it very helpful. But recently the opening hours/days feature has been completely bugged, making it difficult to decide when to go to which museums, etc.! For several locations, the “open days” are wrong on Wanderlog but correct on Google Maps, which makes me confused about where they are getting the information from.

Excellent app!!!. This app is the BEST! Imports all my Hail confirmations and the whole itinerary is accessible at my fingertips! I can get directions from the stops I put in, keep a journal, share itinerary and soooo much more. LOVE!

Type A Trip Planner’s Heaven. I am not one to leave reviews because I find it bothersome, but the creators of this app has outdone themselves. While the app/website can get laggy at times, the amount of free features and usability out shines any issues. Everything is super easy to search up and add to a trip’s itinerary, and you can easily reference useful information straight from a location’s pop up box (i.e. short description, opening hours, reviews, etc.). I’m just so very grateful for the founders because it truly feels like they care about the users and want to create a product that meets a need. 10/10 would recommend to any type a planners. It’s a lifesaver.
Best travel app. Great app for travel plans and documentation

Cant add anything. Cannot add anything to a trip someone shares with you. It’s a gimmick they get you to sign up give your email to view what was shared with you pop up constant offerings to upgrade instead of letting you learn how great the app is then deciding oh hey I’ll pay for this, it is just not stop dead ends. Not functional but pretends to be

Great tool!. Invaluable for our Venice trip!! From top destinations to restaurants - reviews were excellent and helped prioritize places to visit and eat. We’re able to flex the day based on recommendations. Love this tool!
Making wander moments. I absolutely love this handy app. I’ve been using it for years. Such a great organizer tool - recommend it often to those that travel!
Hard to use. This app is hard to use. The onboarding is very long and unnecessary. I don’t find it useful.

Not helpful. Can’t add accommodations that aren’t a hotel or other searchable type, added all our expenses, ticked who paid, which people it involved, went to resolve the payments and who owes who want and none of it made sense, so I had to do it all by hand. It was useful as a place to keep track but ultimately useless. An intuitive interface that didn’t deliver.

Love it!. this is seriously the gold standard of itinerary apps. It is so flexible, intuitive, and helps you visualize your route. An incredible offering of features for the free version and even more impressive extras in the paid version. I love the ability to add times, cost, and estimate travel times by different modes of transportation. I keep discovering new features to love

Exceptional travel app!. Easy to use app to stay organized when traveling before, during and after. I used it for the first time on a trip to London. It gave good tips, especially distance from hotel to points of interest. I add notes and reminders!

Great tool for trip planning. I plan at least one trip every year, usually internationally, and so far I’ve only ever done it with notebook and an email folder for all my confirmations. Wanderlog has made my upcoming trip so much easier to plan, keeping better track of everything I want to do and see. I’ve only used the free version so far, but it’s been so helpful to organize my itinerary I’ll be upgrading to the premium version, so my husband can view and add content. And having the confirmations for everything I’ve booked attached to our trip board will be really helpful.
Love this app. So convenient! Map out all my destination spots and helps so much when planning trips!
5 Stars. Great to help manage expenses on group trips! Would recommend

One stop planning. This app allows for easy trip planning, budgeting, and routes. I have yet to take the trip I’ve planned but it likes like it will even be easy to teach everything we do. It is easy to find and add things to do, and optimize the route. It finds hotels if you’d like. I didn’t use that feature.
A must have when traveling. It’s been a life saver

2026 60th Birthday Celebration Japan Trip. I love Wanderlog travel log app. 
This really helped me to remember where I want to go and what I want to do so I would write it down.

Rambling Rose. I’ve been traveling my entire life. I’m 71 years old. If you add a place to a specific day, it just moves it to the general bucket of places to go. I just want to add certain places at certain times to specific days. You can eventually get there but it’s not the default behavior. Also they show up differently than all your other entries for the day once you do figure it out. Also, one small annoyance is you can’t set the check in and checkout time of a Hotel and Lodging entry. If you forward an email that has one it shows up, but the app doesn’t let you set your own especially on manually created entries. It also keeps showing info boxes like “looks like you haven’t booked lodging” even though it’s right above a lodging entry for the day. Best Travel Trip App. I absolutely love this app for trip planning. Being able to track expenses in one place makes budgeting so much easier, and one of my favorite features is that I can forward all my confirmation emails hotels, flights, tickets and the app automatically organizes them into the correct days on my itinerary. It saves a ton of time and keeps everything streamlined.

I also really appreciate how I can store and manage all my travel details in one place, including timed entries, reservations, and activities. The ability to add everything we want to do and then reorganize it on a computer is a huge plus it makes planning flexible and much more efficient.

Another standout feature is how it shows the distance between destinations and suggests the best way to get from one place to the next. That’s incredibly helpful when trying to make the most of a busy itinerary.

The only downside for me is the trip optimization feature. I don’t feel like it does a great job of organizing the schedule in the most efficient way. I usually end up manually adjusting my plans using this app alongside Google Maps to get a better flow for each day.

Overall, it’s a fantastic planning tool that keeps everything in one place I wouldn’t plan a trip without it.

Perfect for Type A Travelers. I love this app so much. It’s super easy to use and makes planning more complicated trips easier. I love that it offers suggestions, calculates the time between places and allows you to filter your map by days and types of places. My only wish is to have more icon choices.

Obsessed!. I’m keeping a packing list, ‘things to book list’, adding all my transportation tickets and hotel bookings and plan to add my fiance so he can easily view all of this. I plan to buy the pro package before travel so I can upload any additional paperwork needed. Again, highly recommend!!

The best part is you can use the app for free or pay extra for the ‘Pro’ version which just optimizes what you can receive. For example Pro will give you live flight updates among many other things. Can’t recommend this app enough.

Great idea, needs tweaking. I have an upcoming trip with a 12 hour flight to get there. I uploaded my flights and hotels, and for each day I still had to input what city I was in to do the auto-fill feature. 

It’s cool to get suggestions for popular tourist places, but honestly this is something I could just use a personal AI to build. What would change this for me is if you could essentially set a profile including things you like to do, if you prefer tourist destinations or just relaxing, how many places you’d like each day. I really feel like it should be a one step where you do the profile and upload flights/hotels and the rest is handled for you.
